title: Apple (AAPL) Position Cut by Cornerstone Advisors Inc
text:
por Amoldo Sanabria · May 04, 2018 20:20 Apple to Buy Back $100 Billion in Stock
Ramsay Stattman Vela & Price Inc. now owns 52,013 shares of the iPhone maker's stock worth $8,016,000 after buying an additional 1,668 shares during the last quarter. $1,184.42 million flowed into the stock on the tick-up and $1,243.04 million flowed out of the stock on the tick-down, for a money net flow of $58.62 million out of the stock. Apple has a 52 week low of $142.20 and a 52 week high of $183.50.
A number of hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of the business.
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) has been assigned a $175.00 target price by research analysts at Morningstar in a note issued to investors on Wednesday. Nomura reissued a "neutral" rating and issued a $175.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, March 19th. They issued a "buy" rating and a $235.00 price target for the company. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of "Buy" and a consensus price target of $204.00.
Perkins Coie Trust Co reduced its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.7% in the fourth quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink .
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The fund owned 26,358 shares of the iPhone maker's stock after selling 453 shares during the quarter. Stuart Chaussee & Associates Inc. grew its position in Apple by 940.8% during the 4th quarter. Corundum Group Inc. now owns 2,242 shares of the iPhone maker's stock valued at $346,000 after buying an additional 299 shares during the last quarter. Jarislowsky Fraser Ltd lifted its stake in Apple by 22.4% during the third quarter. Oak Point Wealth Management acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter worth $163,000. Jarislowsky Fraser Ltd now owns 22,515 shares of the iPhone maker's stock valued at $3,470,000 after purchasing an additional 4,118 shares during the period. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The company has a market cap of $854,413.06, a PE ratio of 18.89, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.25.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts' consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. The business had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion.
From August 2012 through March 2018, Apple has returned $275 billion to shareholders, including $200 billion in share repurchases. The figure is up more than 10 percent from $655 a year ago, suggesting Apple's iPhone X, which starts at $999, has helped boost prices . During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. equities research analysts expect that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year.
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Investors of record on Monday, May 14th will be issued a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date is Friday, May 11th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.65%. Apple's dividend payout ratio is presently 27.36%.
"Given our confidence in Apple's future, we are very happy to announce that our Board has approved a new $100 billion share repurchase authorization and a 16 percent increase in our quarterly dividend". FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker's stock valued at $115,000 after acquiring an additional 716 shares in the last quarter. Shares repurchase programs are typically an indication that the company's board of directors believes its shares are undervalued.
